# Production functions holding a string literal that opens with EXPLAIN (security-01c-n).
# Observation sessions run under search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp (security-01c-r): a function
# that plans an application's statement sets the application's path with apppath.Pin first.
# <file> <function> pin
# <file> <function> via <function> -- reason   (that function of the package calls apppath.Pin)
# <file> <function> own <function> -- reason   (that function sets its session's own search_path)
# <file> <function> qualified -- reason        (pg_sage's own statement over qualified names)
# <file> <function> text -- reason             (never run as a statement)
internal/agentguard/broker/explain.go explainEnvelopeStatement own call.begin -- the agent's statement, planned in the broker transaction whose search_path is the grant's (pg_catalog, grant schemas, pg_temp)
internal/agentguard/broker/explain.go call.prepareExplain own call.begin -- prepared and planned in the broker transaction call.begin opened on the grant's path
internal/autoexplain/collector.go Collector.explainReadOnly pin
internal/briefing/ground.go statementKeywords text -- a list of statement keywords the grounding check refuses in model text
internal/cases/ddl_safety.go verificationSQLForFinding text -- a verification script shown to the operator, never run by pg_sage
internal/cases/query_actions.go queryInvestigationScriptOutput text -- an investigation script shown to the operator, never run by pg_sage
internal/explain/analyze_guard.go explainNote text -- the result note shown with a plan
internal/explain/explain.go Explainer.runExplainParameterized via Explainer.prepareConn -- prepareConn pins the transaction before PREPARE
internal/explain/explain.go explainSQL via Explainer.prepareConn -- built for Explainer.runExplain, which plans it after prepareConn
internal/explain/explain.go buildResult text -- the result note shown with a plan
internal/mcp/agent_tools.go agentTools text -- the explain_query tool description for the model
internal/optimizer/hypopg_generic.go hypopgSession.explainPreparedSteps via boundSession -- openHypoPGSession pins the session's transaction with boundSession
internal/optimizer/hypopg_session.go hypopgSession.explain via boundSession -- openHypoPGSession pins the session's transaction with boundSession
internal/optimizer/skipscan.go poolPlanner.genericPlans via boundSession -- genericPlans pins its read-only evidence transaction with boundSession
internal/sre/investigator_explain.go runExplain pin
internal/tuner/hint_explain.go compareInTx pin
internal/tuning/rehearsal_measure.go analyze via measurer.measureStatement -- measureStatement pins the clone transaction with apppath.Pin before it runs the proven statement
internal/tuning/rehearsal_measure.go planIn via planOutside -- planOutside and measurer.measureStatement pin the transaction with apppath.Pin before planIn
internal/tuning/store_plan.go postgresStore.explainAfresh via postgresStore.explain -- planned by postgresStore.explain
internal/vectorlab/plan.go postgresSource.planIndexes qualified -- pg_sage's own vector query over pgx.Identifier-quoted schema.table names
internal/verify/ladder_session.go planCosts via planUnderSetting -- planUnderSetting pins its read-only transaction with apppath.Pin before planning the targets
internal/verify/ladder_session.go totalCost text -- an error message naming EXPLAIN
internal/workload/workload.go explainPart text -- a pattern that recognizes EXPLAIN statements
